nodes.label: Inline Theme Bootstrap Script
nodes.rationale: A blocking IIFE in <head> reads localStorage 'theme' (defaulting to dark) and toggles the `dark` class on <html> before React mounts, so the page never flashes the wrong theme. It duplicates ThemeProvider's class toggle deliberately — the provider runs too late to prevent the flash.

nodes.label: Root Mount Point
nodes.rationale: <div id="root"> plus the module script entry at /src/main.tsx — the single Vite entry point for the SPA.
